scenes.headline: How one open model reads pages, speech and screens
scenes.sub: A reasoning core, borrowed specialists, and a confidence score
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Chutney! This open model reads documents, transcribes speech and finds things on screen. Let's open the folder.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: A 27B core plans and calls tools. Specialist models do the reading, and every one of them is a public checkpoint, unmodified.
scenes.say: The idea: a large core plans and calls tools, and small specialists do the reading. Every specialist is someone else's public checkpoint, unmodified.

scenes.title: A mixture of architectures is a tool loop

steps.say: A request arrives with its files. The core decides which tools to call.
It calls specialists: a document reader, a speech recognizer, a segmenter. Results come back to the core.
The core writes the answer. Each specialist's raw output comes back beside it, with boxes and scores.
Call one capability directly, like OCR, and the core never loads.

scenes.label: large files byte-identical to an upstream checkpoint
scenes.say: I compared file hashes with the original repositories. Seventy-six of seventy-nine large files match exactly.

steps.say: OCR runs two readers on one page. A large document reader gets the text right, in reading order, with no scores.
A tiny line detector boxes every line and scores its own reading of it.
Lines are matched by what they say. Each box takes the reader's words and keeps the detector's score.

left.title: Scored
items: OCR lines: the recognizer's own score
left.say: OCR lines carry a real score, from the small recognizer. The safety guard reports a probability.

right.title: Not scored
right.say: Transcripts and detected boxes carry none. And in the released code, every word inherits its line's score.

scenes.title: olmOCR-Bench, as Interfaze's own board lists it
scenes.note: Attaching boxes and scores costs half a point of text accuracy
scenes.say: On the publisher's own board, the stitched pipeline scores half a point below its document reader alone. The stitcher buys boxes and scores, not accuracy.

scenes.text: The new part is the wiring: small specialists supply boxes and scores that a big model cannot.
scenes.say: The new part is the wiring. Small specialists supply the boxes and scores that a big general model cannot.

recap: A 27B core calls public specialist checkpoints
OCR boxes and scores come from the detector
Gate on line scores, not word scores
scenes.say: To recap: a core that calls borrowed specialists, OCR stitched from two readers, and a score you can gate on, line by line.
